limits: Original game is ground truth. No original Mac execution, oracle replay or per-state legal masks occurred. Integer 0..127 checks do not certify original-game legality.
Seven PT entries are historical remote streamhash metadata, bound to this envelope only; no local or independent remote PT read/load, model/Adam/RNG execution or equality proof was performed.

Noncombat potion counts were recomputed for every one of 1024 rank episode rows, with absent keys counted as zero. Their noncombat kind5 meaning is bound to the exact fixed source increment; per-action kind/phase state rows are absent and cannot be independently regenerated from action indices.

Shop repeat exemption source resets once per floor and copies state across SL branches; observed episode and global counts agree with summaries. Per-floor state history is absent, so this is a static source plus aggregated producer evidence check, not original per-floor replay.

Complete log also retains three training-only search over-limit records for seed1733288798, outside dev1024. Dev evaluation overlimits zero do not describe all training history. The one capped search trial has a dedicated fault-code producer log; this is not a mainline death or original-game fault proof.

All combat/search/capacity/loop metrics are recomputed aggregates of producer observations; SL-copy diagnostics are separate from actual completed mainline counters. They are not independently executed rollouts.
faults=0 and truncated=0 are constants in producer summaries and are not independent original-game proofs.
Status/log/queue are byte snapshots taken at potentially different times and include later training; they do not establish final EXIT, actual final charge or current job state.
Historical 3967 RL8 inspection is reused as metadata context only; startup is not reexecuted and no 4032 baseline or historical Mac result is inherited.
